node.title: A=1 core-one trace-free weld exclusion
node.statement: On the official A=1 core-one maximal-degree sharp cap, the trace-free nonzero-weld branch is impossible. The exceptional Z_W allocation contradicts the positive gcd of Q(gamma_0;X) and P_X. The remaining reduced square makes every supported Q_gamma divide P_X, so every bad row has full deficit e_* and C_*=ce_*. Capacity forces b=0,D_*=1,c=1. At that profile the exceptional fiber has degree r-1, requiring deg_X A_1(gamma_0)=D_0-r, while B_X|A and deg_X A=D_0-r permit only D_0-r-1. Hence every surviving profile has an active defect trace of K.
